About Us

Where Sound Meets
Vision

The Refix Studio is Kolkata's creative sanctuary for musicians, filmmakers, and content creators. Nestled in Haltu, we bring together state-of-the-art equipment and a passion for storytelling to help your vision come to life.

Whether you're recording your first track, shooting a cinematic reel, or crafting a brand identity — we are your creative partners from concept to final cut.

Our team believes in authentic art: music that breathes, visuals that speak, and stories that last.

What We Do

Our Services

🎙️
Audiography
Professional recording, mixing & mastering. From vocals to full band arrangements — we capture every nuance of your sound.
🎬
Videography
Cinematic filming for music videos, reels, brand content, and documentary-style storytelling with professional-grade equipment.
✂️
Video Editing
Color grading, cuts, transitions and motion graphics that transform raw footage into compelling visual narratives.
🎨
Graphic Design
Album art, posters, social media creatives, and brand identity design crafted to make your visual presence unforgettable.
📸
Photography
Studio & location photography — artist portraits, product shoots, event coverage, and editorial work with a cinematic eye.
